ns2:course.label: Spanish Grammar and Communicative Language Teaching
ns2:course.description: Survey of major Spanish syntactic and morphological patterns with particular emphasis on the acquisition of Spanish grammar by non- native speakers. Students will develop a sensitivity for appropriate teaching of Spanish grammar. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Required for teacher education. Prerequisite: FLTE 475 or consent of instructor.
